integrity: The transfer factorization and traces were checked with exact symbolic arithmetic, with independent exhaustive profile enumeration for n=3..6; infinite-family claims follow from proof rather than finite experiments. No external independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts labeled-site pure equilibria only for simple C3 Cartesian Cn, n>=3, homogeneous strict zero-or-two-neighbor best responses; it does not cover wider strips, different patterns, or symmetry quotients. Full originality over unindexed enumeration results remains uncertain.
title: Exact equilibrium entropy for the zero-or-two-neighbor public-goods game on triangular toroidal strips
